issue.notes:
Implemented in twill_schema.py, commit fc5bf03.

Design (plan §8.4):
- Migration dataclass + MIGRATIONS registry; ships EMPTY — the v1 tables are the baseline (V1_SCHEMA + inline _apply_additive_columns), not migration consumers; later-phase schema additions append Migration entries.
- Additive-only enforced mechanically at import (_validated/_validate_statement): whitelist of 'CREATE ... IF NOT EXISTS' (table/index/unique index/virtual table/view) and 'ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN', one statement per entry (no embedded semicolons — this excludes triggers by design), contiguous versions from BASELINE_VERSION=1, unique names. A DROP/rename/CREATE-without-IF-NOT-EXISTS fails the process at startup, not half-applied on a database.
- run_migrations: unstamped databases stamp baseline 1; pending migrations apply inside one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction whose commit records meta.schema_version — a failed statement rolls the whole run back (stamp and DDL together). ALTER entries route through the same add-if-missing check as baseline convergence, so re-runs are no-ops.
- Downgrade tolerance: a database stamped above this release's newest migration opens untouched — no statement runs, stamp never lowered, unknown columns/tables kept; the older writer can still insert via named columns. _verify_observation_shape relaxed from exact equality to prefix match so a rolled-back release READS a newer DB that appended observation columns (exact-match would have refused it — that was the one place an older release could not read a newer DB). Pre-v1 Phase 0 shape still rejected with the rebuild hint.

Tests (tests/test_schema.py, +7): baseline stamping + shipped-registry-empty pin; apply-in-order + stamp + idempotent reopen; whole-run rollback on a failed migration; rolled-back-release-reads-newer-DB (writer + read-only + named-column insert); read-only open never stamps; validator rejects non-additive statements and non-contiguous/duplicate/empty names. test_meta_enforces_key_value_state_contract reseeded — the runner now owns the schema_version row. Makefile gains a 'make test' target (unittest discover).

Verification: make test exit=0 (186 tests, clean extraction of fc5bf03), python3 -m compileall -q . exit=0, python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -k Migration exit=0 (7 tests). Pushed to origin/main, origin/main..HEAD empty.
